task: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an life changing round of TextWorld? You do! Here is how to play! First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to make an effort to go west. That done, move west. Okay, and then, make an attempt to venture south. Then, try to venture east. And then, pick up the cucumber from the floor of the study. And if you do that, you're the winner!
